chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about Umm al-Walad. He said: "She is a slave; she may be sold, inherited, and gifted, and her legal ruling is the ruling of a slave."

key_terms.أُمِّ ٱلْوَلَدِ: a bondwoman who has borne a child
key_terms.تُوهَبُ: she may be given as a gift
key_terms.حَدُّهَا: her legal ruling or prescribed status
key_terms.ٱلْأَمَةِ: the female slave whose ruling is the reference point here

ai.seo_question: What is the legal ruling on Umm al-Walad in this hadith from Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning Umm al-Walad. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that she remains legally classified as a bondwoman, and the rulings of sale, inheritance, gifting, and legal status continue to apply to her as they do to a slave.
